scope: Restore four original token scope paths in Amass, Rite of Belzenlok, Shark Typhoon and Circle of Loyalty. Seven actual76-byte token locals and two216-byte test locals replace reused function-wide declarations/two source unions. Native/rebuilt scoped scalar byte-event multisets, initializer IDs, initializer/generator pointers and disjoint lifetimes of overlapping frame allocations are checked. Circle replaces two four-byte vigilance writes through test.message with the original typed token s_key_plus value8. Exact source replay preserves every other byte and all costs, conditions, dynamic operands and native quirks. Correct one reccmp native-address binding: the verified auxiliary callback at2073940 belongs to innistrad_exile_at_end_of_combat_legacy; global matching by its old spelling selected another source unit. The project now consumes explicit auxiliary native/source/name bindings and rejects conflicting addresses or sources. A separate broad token-write screen is discovery only; literal event equality is not proof of arbitrary aliases, dynamic values, complete constructor effects or gameplay.
